gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patient must have histologically confirmed World Health Organization Grade IV glioblastoma.

candidate_evidence.quote: ONC201 is a orally active, small molecule DRD2 antagonist that kills cancer cells but not normal cells.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patient must have had previous therapy with at least radiotherapy.
Unequivocal evidence of recurrence (progressive disease) on contrast-enhanced brain CT or MRI as defined by RANO criteria

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Arm A will explore the intra-tumoral ONC201 concentrations and pharmacodynamic activity in adult EGFR-low glioblastoma patients.

role_evidence.quote: ONC201 will be administered orally, twice a week (2 consecutive days on and 5 days off per week) schedule at a dose of 625mg.

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational oral small molecule, DRD2 antagonist
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: orally active, small molecule DRD2 antagonist that kills cancer cells but not normal cells
arms: Arm A: ONC201 with Surgical Resection in Glioblastoma

source_quote.quote: (1) absence of EGFR gene amplification by FISH, (2) absence of EGFRvIII expression by RT-PCR, and (3) low EGFR expression by IHC.
Patient has a known IDH1 (isocitrate dehydrogenase 1) or IDH2 mutations or 1p/19q co-deletion.
Patient has a known histone H3 K27M mutation.

coder_notes: EGFR-low status is an entry requirement, but the record gives no mechanistic link between EGFR status and ONC201 (a DRD2 antagonist), so candidate_matched is false. IDH and H3K27M appear as exclusions of known mutants (equivalent to requiring wildtype); coded as eligibility rows without matching. cns5_terminology unclear: plain WHO grade IV glioblastoma with IDH-mutant exclusion only for 'known' mutations.
